names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 1 martie, «Sfântul Cuvios Martirie din Zelenesk».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 1 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Μαρτύριος του Ζελένσκ», with the rank word and the place left off.

death.note: doxologia.ro: «Sfântul Martirie a adormit întru Domnul în anul 1603»; the same page says he was born at Veliki Luki «în secolul al XVI-lea», ordained presbyter «în anul 1570» and made abbot «în anul 1582».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

feast.note: doxologia.ro keeps him again on 11 noiembrie, where the day page prints «Sfântul Cuvios Martirie din Zelenesk» (https://doxologia.ro/11-noiembrie, read 25 September 2026) and sends it to the same page and the same life as 1 martie; the head of his own page still reads «1 Martie». The corpus keeps one feast to a church, so he renders on 1 martie only.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 1 martie — «Sfântul Cuvios Martirie din Zelenesk»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Μαρτύριος του Ζελένσκ»

attestations.note: The page heads him «(; - 1603)», gives his name in the world as Menas, puts his birth at Veliki Luki in Russia in the sixteenth century of parents Kosmas and Stephanida who died ten years after it, names the levite of the church of the Annunciation who brought him up and who later became a monk of the Holy Trinity monastery under the name Bogolepios, dates his ordination to the presbyterate by the Archbishop of Novgorod to 1570 and his appointment as abbot to 1582, and prints his last prayer. Its year of repose is the year the corpus already holds.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).
